task_instance: Use the skill's simple-query mode to search for and download 5 images for the query 'neural interface wearable device' into ./images, then verify the downloaded image files exist.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable is searching/downloading images through Google's Custom Search image API with an LLM picking the best result. Every working mode (simple query, batch, note enrichment) calls fetch_images_for_entry, which performs an authenticated HTTP GET to Google's Custom Search endpoint using an account-bound API key plus a Search Engine ID (cx). No such credentials exist in the work directory and the safety rules forbid obtaining, searching for, or using credentials and account-bound/paid services, and forbid reaching external services over the network. Additionally: the API endpoint constant in scripts/api.py is a scrubbed placeholder standing for an unreachable host, so even the request URL cannot be built; the LLM-selection step needs an OpenRouter account key; and the required 'llm' command-line tool (expected at a Homebrew path) is not installed on this machine (not present on PATH). The config-generation mode likewise needs the missing LLM CLI and an OpenRouter account key.
evidence: Read SKILL.md: Requirements list a Google Custom Search API key and Search Engine ID, an OpenRouter API key, and the 'llm' CLI. Read scripts/config.py (resolve_credentials/get_openrouter_key look up Google key, cx, and OpenRouter key from env or .env) and scripts/google_image_search.py (main() exits with 'Missing API key' / 'Missing Search Engine ID (cx)' when absent for all non-generate modes; LLM selection called in every search path). Read scripts/api.py: http_get() opens a real network request to the search endpoint, and API_ENDPOINT is the scrubbed placeholder standing for an unreachable host. Environment checks from the work directory: python3 present (3.13.17); 'which llm' returned nothing and /opt/homebrew/bin/llm does not exist, so the required LLM CLI is absent. No .env file exists in the work directory and none may be created with real keys. Copied scripts and references into the work directory; attempting to execute the copied simple-query command was additionally denied by the runtime's external-code classifier. Files produced: result.json, plus local copies of scripts/ and references/ under the work directory.
